         SELECT qi.rfq_id,

            s.id AS supplier_id,

            q.quote_ref,
            q.quote_date,
            q.valid_until,
            q.freight_total,
            q.minimum_order_value,
            ql.id AS quote_line_id,
            ql.unit_price,
            ql.available_qty,
            ql.lead_days,
            ql.discount_percent,
            ql.tax_percent,
            ql.moq,
            ql.order_multiple,
            round(ql.unit_price * (1::numeric - ql.discount_percent / 100.0), 4) AS net_unit_price,
            round(ql.unit_price * (1::numeric - ql.discount_percent / 100.0) * (1::numeric + ql.tax_percent / 100.0), 4) AS effective_unit_price,
            sum(GREATEST(LEAST(COALESCE(ql.available_qty, qi.requested_qty), qi.requested_qty), 0::numeric)) OVER (PARTITION BY q.id) AS quote_qty_basis
           FROM proc_rfq_items qi
             JOIN proc_quotes q ON q.rfq_id = qi.rfq_id
             JOIN proc_suppliers s ON s.id = q.supplier_id AND s.active = true
             JOIN proc_quote_lines ql ON ql.quote_id = q.id AND ql.rfq_item_id = qi.id
          WHERE (q.status = ANY (ARRAY['received'::text, 'reviewed'::text, 'selected'::text])) AND ql.unit_price >= 0::numeric AND (q.valid_until IS NULL OR q.valid_until >= (now() AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Colombo'::text)::date)
        ), landed AS (
         SELECT lc.rfq_id,
            lc.rfq_item_id,
            lc.requirement_id,
            lc.requested_qty,
            lc.supplier_id,
            lc.supplier_code,
            lc.supplier_name,
            lc.quote_id,
            lc.quote_ref,
            lc.quote_date,
            lc.valid_until,
            lc.freight_total,
            lc.minimum_order_value,
            lc.quote_line_id,
            lc.unit_price,
            lc.available_qty,
            lc.lead_days,
            lc.discount_percent,
            lc.tax_percent,
            lc.moq,
            lc.order_multiple,
            lc.net_unit_price,
            lc.effective_unit_price,
            lc.quote_qty_basis,
            round(
                CASE
                    WHEN COALESCE(lc.quote_qty_basis, 0::numeric) > 0::numeric THEN lc.freight_total / lc.quote_qty_basis
                    ELSE 0::numeric
                END, 4) AS freight_unit_cost,
            round(lc.effective_unit_price +
                CASE
                    WHEN COALESCE(lc.quote_qty_basis, 0::numeric) > 0::numeric THEN lc.freight_total / lc.quote_qty_basis
                    ELSE 0::numeric
                END, 4) AS landed_unit_cost
           FROM line_cost lc
        )
 SELECT rfq_id,
    rfq_item_id,
    requirement_id,
    supplier_id,
    supplier_code,
    supplier_name,
    quote_id,
    quote_ref,
    quote_line_id,
    unit_price,
    available_qty,
    lead_days,
    discount_percent,
    tax_percent,
    dense_rank() OVER (PARTITION BY rfq_item_id ORDER BY effective_unit_price, supplier_code) AS price_rank,
    effective_unit_price,
    valid_until,
    net_unit_price,
    requested_qty,
    quote_date,
    freight_total,
    minimum_order_value,
    moq,
    order_multiple,
    quote_qty_basis,
    freight_unit_cost,
    landed_unit_cost,
    dense_rank() OVER (PARTITION BY rfq_item_id ORDER BY landed_unit_cost, supplier_code) AS landed_rank
   FROM landed;

views.name: proc_v_invoiceable_po_lines

views.name: proc_v_urgent_actions
views.definition:
WITH loc AS (
         SELECT proc_locations.id
           FROM proc_locations
          WHERE proc_locations.active = true
          ORDER BY proc_locations.created_at
         LIMIT 1
        ), reqs AS (
         SELECT 'existing_item'::text AS action_type,
            r.id AS action_id,
            r.item_id,
            NULL::uuid AS missing_request_id,
            r.requirement_no AS reference_no,
            i.description,
            i.brand,
            i.category,
            i.main_group,
            i.subgroup,
            i.size,
            i.uom,
            i.movement,
            r.adjusted_qty - r.ordered_qty AS required_qty,
                CASE
                    WHEN r.priority = 'urgent'::text OR r.customer_paid OR r.urgency_reason = 'zero_stock'::text THEN 'urgent'::text
                    WHEN r.priority = 'high'::text OR i.movement = 'FAST'::text THEN 'high'::text
                    ELSE r.priority
                END AS effective_priority,
            r.urgency_reason,
            r.customer_paid,
            r.customer_reference,
            r.request_image_path AS image_path,
            r.status,
            r.approval_status,
            r.created_by,
            r.created_at,
            b.qty AS book_stock,
                CASE r.priority
                    WHEN 'urgent'::text THEN 100
                    WHEN 'high'::text THEN 70
                    WHEN 'normal'::text THEN 40
                    ELSE 10
                END +
                CASE
                    WHEN r.customer_paid THEN 50
                    ELSE 0
                END +
                CASE
                    WHEN COALESCE(b.qty, 0::numeric) = 0::numeric THEN 40
                    ELSE 0
                END +
                CASE i.movement
                    WHEN 'FAST'::text THEN 20
                    WHEN 'NORMAL'::text THEN 10
                    ELSE 0
                END +
                CASE
                    WHEN r.urgency_reason = ANY (ARRAY['bulk_sale'::text, 'customer_request'::text]) THEN 25
                    ELSE 0
                END AS priority_score
           FROM proc_requirements r
             JOIN proc_items i ON i.id = r.item_id
             CROSS JOIN loc
             LEFT JOIN proc_stock_balances b ON b.item_id = i.id AND b.location_id = loc.id
          WHERE (r.status <> ALL (ARRAY['received'::text, 'closed'::text, 'cancelled'::text])) AND GREATEST(r.adjusted_qty - r.ordered_qty, 0::numeric) > 0::numeric AND ((r.priority = ANY (ARRAY['urgent'::text, 'high'::text])) OR r.urgency_reason IS NOT NULL OR i.movement = 'FAST'::text OR COALESCE(b.qty, 0::numeric) = 0::numeric)
        ), missing AS (
         SELECT 'missing_item'::text AS action_type,
            q.id AS action_id,
            q.converted_item_id AS item_id,
            q.id AS missing_request_id,
            q.request_no AS reference_no,
            q.proposed_name AS description,
            q.brand,
            q.category,
            q.main_group,
            q.subgroup,
            q.size,
            q.uom,
            q.movement,
            q.required_qty,
                CASE
                    WHEN q.customer_paid OR q.priority = 'urgent'::text THEN 'urgent'::text
                    WHEN q.movement = 'FAST'::text OR q.priority = 'high'::text THEN 'high'::text
                    ELSE q.priority
                END AS effective_priority,
            q.urgency_reason,
            q.customer_paid,
            q.customer_reference,
            q.image_path,
            q.status,
            NULL::text AS approval_status,
            q.created_by,
            q.created_at,
            NULL::numeric AS book_stock,
                CASE q.priority
                    WHEN 'urgent'::text THEN 100
                    WHEN 'high'::text THEN 70
                    WHEN 'normal'::text THEN 40
                    ELSE 10
                END +
                CASE
                    WHEN q.customer_paid THEN 50
                    ELSE 0
                END +
                CASE q.movement
                    WHEN 'FAST'::text THEN 20
                    WHEN 'NORMAL'::text THEN 10
                    ELSE 0
                END +
                CASE
                    WHEN q.urgency_reason = ANY (ARRAY['bulk_sale'::text, 'customer_request'::text]) THEN 25
                    ELSE 0
                END AS priority_score
           FROM proc_item_requests q
          WHERE q.status = ANY (ARRAY['pending_review'::text, 'approved'::text])
        )
 SELECT reqs.action_type,
    reqs.action_id,
    reqs.item_id,
    reqs.missing_request_id,
    reqs.reference_no,
    reqs.description,
    reqs.brand,
    reqs.category,
    reqs.main_group,
    reqs.subgroup,
    reqs.size,
    reqs.uom,
    reqs.movement,
    reqs.required_qty,
    reqs.effective_priority,
    reqs.urgency_reason,
    reqs.customer_paid,
    reqs.customer_reference,
    reqs.image_path,
    reqs.status,
    reqs.approval_status,
    reqs.created_by,
    reqs.created_at,
    reqs.book_stock,
    reqs.priority_score
   FROM reqs
UNION ALL
 SELECT missing.action_type,
    missing.action_id,
    missing.item_id,
    missing.missing_request_id,
    missing.reference_no,
    missing.description,
    missing.brand,
    missing.category,
    missing.main_group,
    missing.subgroup,
    missing.size,
    missing.uom,
    missing.movement,
    missing.required_qty,
    missing.effective_priority,
    missing.urgency_reason,
    missing.customer_paid,
    missing.customer_reference,
    missing.image_path,
    missing.status,
    missing.approval_status,
    missing.created_by,
    missing.created_at,
    missing.book_stock,
    missing.priority_score
   FROM missing;

views.name: proc_v_three_way_match
views.definition:
WITH inv AS (
         SELECT il.po_line_id,
            sum(il.qty) AS invoiced_qty,
            sum(round(il.qty * il.unit_price * (1::numeric - il.discount_percent / 100.0) * (1::numeric + il.tax_percent / 100.0), 2)) AS invoiced_value
           FROM proc_invoice_lines il
             JOIN proc_supplier_invoices si ON si.id = il.invoice_id
          WHERE si.status <> 'rejected'::text
          GROUP BY il.po_line_id
        ), rec AS (
         SELECT gl.po_line_id,
            sum(gl.accepted_qty) AS accepted_qty,
            sum(gl.rejected_qty) AS rejected_qty
           FROM proc_grn_lines gl
             JOIN proc_grns g ON g.id = gl.grn_id
          WHERE g.status = 'posted'::text
          GROUP BY gl.po_line_id
        )
 SELECT po.id AS po_id,
    po.po_no,
    po.status AS po_status,
    s.id AS supplier_id,
    s.supplier_code,
    s.name AS supplier_name,
    pl.id AS po_line_id,
    i.item_code,
    i.category,
    i.description,
    i.size,
    i.uom,
    pl.qty AS ordered_qty,
    COALESCE(inv.invoiced_qty, 0::numeric) AS invoiced_qty,
    COALESCE(rec.accepted_qty, 0::numeric) AS received_qty,
    COALESCE(rec.rejected_qty, 0::numeric) AS rejected_qty,
    COALESCE(inv.invoiced_qty, 0::numeric) - pl.qty AS invoice_qty_variance,
    COALESCE(rec.accepted_qty, 0::numeric) - pl.qty AS receipt_qty_variance,
    pl.line_total AS ordered_value,
    COALESCE(inv.invoiced_value, 0::numeric) AS invoiced_value,
    COALESCE(inv.invoiced_value, 0::numeric) - pl.line_total AS invoice_value_variance,
        CASE
            WHEN COALESCE(inv.invoiced_qty, 0::numeric) = pl.qty AND COALESCE(rec.accepted_qty, 0::numeric) = pl.qty AND abs(COALESCE(inv.invoiced_value, 0::numeric) - pl.line_total) < 0.01 THEN 'matched'::text
            ELSE 'variance'::text
        END AS status,
    po.po_date
   FROM proc_po_lines pl
     JOIN proc_purchase_orders po ON po.id = pl.po_id
     JOIN proc_suppliers s ON s.id = po.supplier_id
     JOIN proc_items i ON i.id = pl.item_id
     LEFT JOIN inv ON inv.po_line_id = pl.id
     LEFT JOIN rec ON rec.po_line_id = pl.id;

   FROM proc_po_lines pl

views.name: proc_v_stock_check_due
views.definition:
WITH feature_cfg AS (
         SELECT COALESCE(proc_feature_settings.config, '{}'::jsonb) AS cfg
           FROM proc_feature_settings
          WHERE proc_feature_settings.feature_key = 'stock.cycle_counting'::text
         LIMIT 1
        ), cfg AS (
         SELECT COALESCE(NULLIF(feature_cfg.cfg ->> 'fast_days'::text, ''::text)::integer, 7) AS fast_days,
            COALESCE(NULLIF(feature_cfg.cfg ->> 'normal_days'::text, ''::text)::integer, 14) AS normal_days,
            COALESCE(NULLIF(feature_cfg.cfg ->> 'slow_days'::text, ''::text)::integer, 28) AS slow_days
           FROM feature_cfg
        ), loc AS (
         SELECT proc_locations.id
           FROM proc_locations
          WHERE proc_locations.active = true
          ORDER BY proc_locations.created_at
         LIMIT 1
        )
 SELECT i.id AS item_id,
    i.item_code,
    i.category,
    i.description,
    i.main_group,
    i.subgroup,
    i.size,
    i.uom,
    i.movement,
    i.max_stock,
    i.reorder_level,
    b.qty AS book_stock,
    b.last_counted_at,
        CASE i.movement
            WHEN 'FAST'::text THEN cfg.fast_days
            WHEN 'SLOW'::text THEN cfg.slow_days
            ELSE cfg.normal_days
        END AS check_every_days,
        CASE
            WHEN b.last_counted_at IS NULL THEN (now() AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Colombo'::text)::date
            ELSE (b.last_counted_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Colombo'::text)::date +
            CASE i.movement
                WHEN 'FAST'::text THEN cfg.fast_days
                WHEN 'SLOW'::text THEN cfg.slow_days
                ELSE cfg.normal_days
            END
        END AS next_check_date,
    b.last_counted_at IS NULL OR ((b.last_counted_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Colombo'::text)::date +
        CASE i.movement
            WHEN 'FAST'::text THEN cfg.fast_days
            WHEN 'SLOW'::text THEN cfg.slow_days
            ELSE cfg.normal_days
        END) <= (now() AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Colombo'::text)::date AS is_due,
        CASE
            WHEN b.last_counted_at IS NULL THEN NULL::integer
            ELSE GREATEST((now() AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Colombo'::text)::date - ((b.last_counted_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Colombo'::text)::date +
            CASE i.movement
                WHEN 'FAST'::text THEN cfg.fast_days
                WHEN 'SLOW'::text THEN cfg.slow_days
                ELSE cfg.normal_days
            END), 0)
        END AS days_overdue,
    i.brand
   FROM proc_items i
     CROSS JOIN cfg
     CROSS JOIN loc
     LEFT JOIN proc_stock_balances b ON b.item_id = i.id AND b.location_id = loc.id
  WHERE i.active = true;

views.name: proc_v_supplier_performance
views.definition:
WITH quote_stats AS (
         SELECT q.supplier_id,
            count(DISTINCT q.id) AS quote_count,
            avg(ql.lead_days) FILTER (WHERE ql.lead_days IS NOT NULL) AS avg_quoted_lead_days,
            count(*) FILTER (WHERE ql.id IS NOT NULL) AS quoted_line_count
           FROM proc_quotes q
             LEFT JOIN proc_quote_lines ql ON ql.quote_id = q.id
          GROUP BY q.supplier_id
        ), award_stats AS (
         SELECT a_1.supplier_id,
            count(*) AS awarded_line_count,
            sum(a_1.awarded_qty) AS awarded_qty,
            sum(a_1.awarded_qty * ql.unit_price * (1::numeric - ql.discount_percent / 100.0) * (1::numeric + ql.tax_percent / 100.0)) AS awarded_value
           FROM proc_awards a_1
             LEFT JOIN proc_quote_lines ql ON ql.id = a_1.quote_line_id
          GROUP BY a_1.supplier_id
        ), po_stats AS (
         SELECT po.supplier_id,
            count(DISTINCT po.id) AS po_count,
            sum(po.total) FILTER (WHERE po.status <> 'cancelled'::text) AS po_value
           FROM proc_purchase_orders po
          GROUP BY po.supplier_id
        ), fill_stats AS (
         SELECT po.supplier_id,
            sum(pl.qty) FILTER (WHERE po.status = ANY (ARRAY['received'::text, 'closed'::text])) AS completed_order_qty,
            sum(COALESCE(rec.accepted_qty, 0::numeric)) FILTER (WHERE po.status = ANY (ARRAY['received'::text, 'closed'::text])) AS completed_accepted_qty
           FROM proc_purchase_orders po
             JOIN proc_po_lines pl ON pl.po_id = po.id
             LEFT JOIN ( SELECT gl.po_line_id,
                    sum(gl.accepted_qty) AS accepted_qty
                   FROM proc_grn_lines gl
                     JOIN proc_grns g ON g.id = gl.grn_id AND g.status = 'posted'::text
                  GROUP BY gl.po_line_id) rec ON rec.po_line_id = pl.id
          GROUP BY po.supplier_id
        ), invoice_stats AS (
         SELECT proc_supplier_invoices.supplier_id,
            count(*) AS invoice_count,
            count(*) FILTER (WHERE proc_supplier_invoices.status = 'variance'::text) AS invoice_variance_count
           FROM proc_supplier_invoices
          GROUP BY proc_supplier_invoices.supplier_id
        )
 SELECT s.id AS supplier_id,
    s.supplier_code,
    s.name AS supplier_name,
    s.active,
    COALESCE(qs.quote_count, 0::bigint) AS quote_count,
    COALESCE(qs.quoted_line_count, 0::bigint) AS quoted_line_count,
    round(COALESCE(qs.avg_quoted_lead_days, 0::numeric), 1) AS avg_quoted_lead_days,
    COALESCE(a.awarded_line_count, 0::bigint) AS awarded_line_count,
    COALESCE(a.awarded_qty, 0::numeric) AS awarded_qty,
    round(COALESCE(a.awarded_value, 0::numeric), 2) AS awarded_value,
    COALESCE(p.po_count, 0::bigint) AS po_count,
    round(COALESCE(p.po_value, 0::numeric), 2) AS po_value,
        CASE
            WHEN COALESCE(f.completed_order_qty, 0::numeric) > 0::numeric THEN round(COALESCE(f.completed_accepted_qty, 0::numeric) / f.completed_order_qty * 100::numeric, 1)
            ELSE NULL::numeric
        END AS completed_fill_rate_pct,
    COALESCE(iv.invoice_count, 0::bigint) AS invoice_count,
    COALESCE(iv.invoice_variance_count, 0::bigint) AS invoice_variance_count
   FROM proc_suppliers s
     LEFT JOIN quote_stats qs ON qs.supplier_id = s.id
     LEFT JOIN award_stats a ON a.supplier_id = s.id
     LEFT JOIN po_stats p ON p.supplier_id = s.id
     LEFT JOIN fill_stats f ON f.supplier_id = s.id
     LEFT JOIN invoice_stats iv ON iv.supplier_id = s.id;

SELECT il.id AS invoice_line_id,
    il.invoice_id,
    il.po_line_id,
    i.item_code,
    i.description,
    i.size,
    i.uom,
    pl.qty AS po_qty,

    il.qty - pl.qty AS qty_variance,
    pl.unit_price AS po_unit_price,
    il.unit_price AS invoice_unit_price,
    il.unit_price - pl.unit_price AS price_variance,
    pl.discount_percent AS po_discount_percent,
    il.discount_percent AS invoice_discount_percent,
    il.discount_percent - pl.discount_percent AS discount_variance,
    pl.tax_percent AS po_tax_percent,
    il.tax_percent AS invoice_tax_percent,
    il.tax_percent - pl.tax_percent AS tax_variance,
    round(pl.unit_price * (1::numeric - pl.discount_percent / 100.0) * (1::numeric + pl.tax_percent / 100.0), 4) AS po_effective_unit_cost,
    round(il.unit_price * (1::numeric - il.discount_percent / 100.0) * (1::numeric + il.tax_percent / 100.0), 4) AS invoice_effective_unit_cost,
    round(il.unit_price * (1::numeric - il.discount_percent / 100.0) * (1::numeric + il.tax_percent / 100.0) - pl.unit_price * (1::numeric - pl.discount_percent / 100.0) * (1::numeric + pl.tax_percent / 100.0), 4) AS effective_unit_cost_variance,
    si.invoice_no,
    si.invoice_date,
    si.status AS invoice_status,
    si.variance_resolution_status,
    si.variance_resolution_action,
    si.variance_resolution_notes,
    si.variance_credit_note_no,
    s.id AS supplier_id,
    s.supplier_code,
    s.name AS supplier_name
   FROM proc_invoice_lines il
     JOIN proc_supplier_invoices si ON si.id = il.invoice_id
     JOIN proc_suppliers s ON s.id = si.supplier_id
     JOIN proc_po_lines pl ON pl.id = il.po_line_id
     JOIN proc_items i ON i.id = il.item_id
  WHERE il.qty <> pl.qty OR il.unit_price <> pl.unit_price OR il.discount_percent <> pl.discount_percent OR il.tax_percent <> pl.tax_percent;

SELECT ( SELECT count(*) AS count
           FROM proc_items
          WHERE proc_items.active) AS active_items,
    ( SELECT count(*) AS count
           FROM proc_requirements
          WHERE proc_requirements.status <> ALL (ARRAY['received'::text, 'closed'::text, 'cancelled'::text])) AS open_requirements,
    ( SELECT count(*) AS count
           FROM proc_requirements
          WHERE proc_requirements.adjusted_qty > proc_requirements.ordered_qty AND (proc_requirements.status <> ALL (ARRAY['closed'::text, 'cancelled'::text]))) AS still_to_order,
    ( SELECT count(*) AS count
           FROM proc_requirements
          WHERE proc_requirements.ordered_qty > proc_requirements.received_qty AND (proc_requirements.status <> ALL (ARRAY['closed'::text, 'cancelled'::text]))) AS awaiting_receipt,
    ( SELECT count(*) AS count
           FROM proc_purchase_orders
          WHERE proc_purchase_orders.status = ANY (ARRAY['pending_approval'::text, 'approved'::text, 'sent'::text, 'partially_received'::text])) AS open_pos,
    ( SELECT COALESCE(sum(proc_purchase_orders.total), 0::numeric) AS "coalesce"
           FROM proc_purchase_orders
          WHERE proc_purchase_orders.status <> 'cancelled'::text) AS po_value,
    ( SELECT count(*) AS count
           FROM proc_supplier_invoices
          WHERE proc_supplier_invoices.status = 'variance'::text) AS invoice_variances,

           FROM proc_stock_counts
          WHERE proc_stock_counts.status = 'draft'::text) AS draft_counts;

views.name: proc_v_supplier_performance_v2
views.definition:
WITH delivery AS (
         SELECT p.supplier_id,
            count(DISTINCT p.id) FILTER (WHERE p.status <> ALL (ARRAY['cancelled'::text, 'draft'::text, 'pending_approval'::text])) AS po_count,
            sum(
                CASE
                    WHEN p.status <> ALL (ARRAY['cancelled'::text, 'draft'::text, 'pending_approval'::text]) THEN GREATEST(r.ordered_qty, 0::numeric)
                    ELSE 0::numeric
                END) AS ordered_units,
            sum(
                CASE
                    WHEN p.status <> ALL (ARRAY['cancelled'::text, 'draft'::text, 'pending_approval'::text]) THEN GREATEST(r.total_accepted_qty, 0::numeric)
                    ELSE 0::numeric
                END) AS accepted_units,
            sum(
                CASE
                    WHEN p.status <> ALL (ARRAY['cancelled'::text, 'draft'::text, 'pending_approval'::text]) THEN GREATEST(r.total_rejected_qty, 0::numeric)
                    ELSE 0::numeric
                END) AS rejected_units
           FROM proc_v_receipt_reconciliation r
             JOIN proc_purchase_orders p ON p.id = r.po_id
          GROUP BY p.supplier_id
        ), quotation AS (
         SELECT q_1.supplier_id,
            count(DISTINCT q_1.id) AS quote_count
           FROM proc_quotes q_1
          GROUP BY q_1.supplier_id
        )
 SELECT s.id AS supplier_id,
    s.name AS supplier_name,
    COALESCE(d.po_count, 0::bigint)::integer AS po_count,
    COALESCE(q.quote_count, 0::bigint)::integer AS quote_count,
        CASE
            WHEN COALESCE(d.ordered_units, 0::numeric) > 0::numeric THEN round(100::numeric * LEAST(d.accepted_units, d.ordered_units) / NULLIF(d.ordered_units, 0::numeric), 1)
            ELSE NULL::numeric
        END AS fulfilment_pct,
        CASE
            WHEN (COALESCE(d.accepted_units, 0::numeric) + COALESCE(d.rejected_units, 0::numeric)) > 0::numeric THEN round(100::numeric * d.accepted_units / NULLIF(d.accepted_units + d.rejected_units, 0::numeric), 1)
            ELSE NULL::numeric
        END AS acceptance_pct,
    NULL::numeric AS on_time_pct,
        CASE
            WHEN COALESCE(d.po_count, 0::bigint) < 3 THEN 'insufficient_data'::text
            ELSE 'delivery_history_available'::text
        END AS evidence_status
   FROM proc_suppliers s
     LEFT JOIN delivery d ON d.supplier_id = s.id
     LEFT JOIN quotation q ON q.supplier_id = s.id;

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.proc_access_allowed()
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
 select private.proc_access_reason()='allowed'
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.proc_access_in_window(p_days integer[], p_start time without time zone, p_end time without time zone, p_now timestamp with time zone DEFAULT now())
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
 select extract(dow from p_now at time zone 'Asia/Colombo')::integer=any(p_days)
 and (p_now at time zone 'Asia/Colombo')::time>=p_start
 and (p_now at time zone 'Asia/Colombo')::time<p_end
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.proc_access_rule()
 RETURNS private.proc_access_rules
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
 select r from private.proc_access_rules r
 where r.scope_id in (auth.uid(),'00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000'::uuid)
 order by (r.scope_id=auth.uid()) desc limit 1
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.proc_access_super_admin()
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
 select exists(select 1 from public.proc_profiles p join public.proc_roles r on r.role_key=p.role_key
 where p.id=auth.uid() and p.active and p.deleted_at is null and r.enabled
 and p.role_key='admin' and p.role='admin' and r.protected and r.base_role='admin')
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.proc_assert_access()
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
begin
 -- Preserve existing server-to-server worker execution with its signed JWT.
 if auth.jwt()->>'role'='service_role' then return;end if;
 if not private.proc_access_allowed() then raise exception 'GH Procurement access restricted: %',private.proc_access_reason() using errcode='42501';end if;
end $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.proc_assert_data_admin()
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
begin
 if auth.uid() is null or not exists(select 1 from public.proc_profiles p join public.proc_roles r on r.role_key=p.role_key where p.id=auth.uid() and p.active and p.role_key='admin' and r.enabled) then
  raise exception 'Only an active Super Admin can delete items or reset data' using errcode='42501';
 end if;
 perform private.proc_assert_permission('admin.configure_app');
end $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.proc_assert_permission(p_permission text)
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
begin
  if not private.proc_has_permission(p_permission) then
    raise exception 'Permission denied: %',p_permission using errcode='42501';
  end if;
end $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.proc_audit_row()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
begin
  insert into public.proc_audit_logs(table_name,record_id,action,old_data,new_data,user_id)
  values (
    tg_table_name,
    case when tg_op='DELETE' then old.id else new.id end,
    tg_op,
    case when tg_op in ('UPDATE','DELETE') then to_jsonb(old) else null end,
    case when tg_op in ('INSERT','UPDATE') then to_jsonb(new) else null end,
    auth.uid()
  );
  return coalesce(new,old);
end
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.proc_automation_sweep_v1()
 RETURNS integer
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
 SET "TimeZone" TO 'Asia/Colombo'
AS $function$
declare
  reminder_hours_v integer:=24;
  po_send_hours_v integer:=4;
  touched integer:=0;
begin
  select greatest(coalesce(nullif(config->>'reminder_hours','')::integer,24),1)
  into reminder_hours_v
  from public.proc_feature_settings where feature_key='quotes.minimum_quotes';
  reminder_hours_v:=greatest(coalesce(reminder_hours_v,24),1);

  select greatest(coalesce(nullif(config->>'po_send_reminder_hours','')::integer,4),1)
  into po_send_hours_v
  from public.proc_feature_settings where feature_key='procurement.straight_through';
  po_send_hours_v:=greatest(coalesce(po_send_hours_v,4),1);

  insert into public.proc_automation_jobs(job_type,entity_type,entity_id,status,payload,last_error,created_by,updated_at)
  select 'rfq_reminder','rfq',q.id,'needs_action',
         jsonb_build_object(
           'rfq_no',q.rfq_no,
           'waiting_suppliers',count(*),
           'due_date',q.due_date
         ),
         'Supplier quotation reminder is due.',null,now()
  from public.proc_rfqs q
  join public.proc_rfq_suppliers rs on rs.rfq_id=q.id
  where q.status in ('sent','partially_quoted')
    and rs.status in ('sent','viewed')
    and rs.sent_at is not null
    and rs.sent_at<=now()-make_interval(hours=>reminder_hours_v)
  group by q.id,q.rfq_no,q.due_date
  on conflict(job_type,entity_id) do update
  set status='needs_action',payload=excluded.payload,last_error=excluded.last_error,updated_at=now();
  get diagnostics touched=row_count;

  update public.proc_automation_jobs j
  set status='completed',last_error=null,updated_at=now()
  where j.job_type='rfq_reminder' and j.status<>'completed'
    and not exists(
      select 1 from public.proc_rfq_suppliers rs
      where rs.rfq_id=j.entity_id and rs.status in ('sent','viewed')
    );

  insert into public.proc_automation_jobs(job_type,entity_type,entity_id,status,payload,last_error,created_by,updated_at)
  select 'po_send','po',po.id,'needs_action',
         jsonb_build_object('po_no',po.po_no,'supplier_id',po.supplier_id,'total',po.total),
         'Approved PO has not yet been confirmed as sent to the supplier.',null,now()
  from public.proc_purchase_orders po
  where po.status='approved'
    and po.approved_at is not null
    and po.approved_at<=now()-make_interval(hours=>po_send_hours_v)
  on conflict(job_type,entity_id) do update
  set status='needs_action',payload=excluded.payload,last_error=excluded.last_error,updated_at=now();

  update public.proc_automation_jobs j
  set status='completed',last_error=null,updated_at=now()
  where j.job_type='po_send' and j.status<>'completed'
    and exists(select 1 from public.proc_purchase_orders po where po.id=j.entity_id and po.status<>'approved');

  insert into public.proc_automation_jobs(job_type,entity_type,entity_id,status,payload,last_error,created_by,updated_at)
  select 'po_delivery_overdue','po',po.id,'needs_action',
         jsonb_build_object('po_no',po.po_no,'supplier_id',po.supplier_id,'expected_date',po.expected_date),
         'Purchase order is past its expected date and is not fully received.',null,now()
  from public.proc_purchase_orders po
  where po.status in ('sent','partially_received')
    and po.expected_date is not null
    and po.expected_date<current_date
  on conflict(job_type,entity_id) do update
  set status='needs_action',payload=excluded.payload,last_error=excluded.last_error,updated_at=now();

  update public.proc_automation_jobs j
  set status='completed',last_error=null,updated_at=now()
  where j.job_type='po_delivery_overdue' and j.status<>'completed'
    and exists(select 1 from public.proc_purchase_orders po where po.id=j.entity_id and po.status not in ('sent','partially_received'));

  return touched;
end
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.proc_company_count_outcomes(p_count_id uuid)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
 SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
  'description',i.description,'current_stock',l.current_stock,'sufficient_stock',l.sufficient_stock,
  'shortage_qty',l.required_qty,'committed_qty',coalesce(o.qty,0),
  'uncovered_qty',greatest(l.required_qty-coalesce(o.qty,0),0),
  'orders',coalesce(o.refs,'[]'::jsonb),'rfqs',coalesce(q.refs,'[]'::jsonb),
  'needs_review',coalesce(o.qty,0)>l.required_qty OR
    (l.required_qty>coalesce(o.qty,0) AND q.refs IS NULL) OR
    (q.refs IS NOT NULL AND coalesce(q.qty,0)<>greatest(l.required_qty-coalesce(o.qty,0),0)),
  'reason',CASE WHEN coalesce(o.qty,0)>l.required_qty THEN 'Existing order exceeds the latest shortage; review before changing or sending it.'
    WHEN l.required_qty>coalesce(o.qty,0) AND o.qty>0 THEN 'Stock need changed while an order is outstanding. Additional purchasing needs manual review.'
    WHEN q.refs IS NOT NULL AND coalesce(q.qty,0)<>greatest(l.required_qty-coalesce(o.qty,0),0) THEN 'Active RFQ quantity differs from the latest uncovered shortage; review before awarding.'
    WHEN l.required_qty>coalesce(o.qty,0) AND q.refs IS NOT NULL THEN 'An RFQ is already active. Review the latest quantity before awarding.'
    WHEN l.required_qty>coalesce(o.qty,0) THEN 'Shortage remains for review.'
    WHEN l.required_qty>0 THEN 'Covered by existing purchase orders.'
    ELSE 'No purchasing needed for this count.' END
 ) ORDER BY i.description,l.id),'[]'::jsonb)
 FROM public.proc_stock_count_lines l JOIN public.proc_stock_counts c ON c.id=l.count_id
 JOIN public.proc_items i ON i.id=l.item_id
 LEFT JOIN LATERAL (SELECT sum(remaining_qty) qty,jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('id',po_id,'number',po_no,'status',po_status,'qty',remaining_qty)) refs
   FROM private.proc_company_open_orders(l.item_id,c.location_id)) o ON true
 LEFT JOIN LATERAL (SELECT sum(ri.requested_qty) qty,jsonb_agg(DISTINCT jsonb_build_object('id',rf.id,'number',rf.rfq_no,'status',rf.status)) refs
   FROM public.proc_requirements r JOIN public.proc_rfq_items ri ON ri.requirement_id=r.id
   JOIN public.proc_rfqs rf ON rf.id=ri.rfq_id
   WHERE r.item_id=l.item_id AND r.location_id=c.location_id
   AND rf.status IN ('draft','prepared','sent','partially_quoted','quoted')) q ON true
 WHERE l.count_id=p_count_id
$function$

 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
begin
  if auth.role()='service_role' then return case when tg_op='DELETE' then old else new end; end if;
  if tg_op='UPDATE'
     and new.id=auth.uid()
     and new.id=old.id
     and new.display_name is not distinct from old.display_name
     and new.role is not distinct from old.role
     and new.role_key is not distinct from old.role_key
     and new.active is not distinct from old.active
     and new.created_at is not distinct from old.created_at
     and new.language is distinct from old.language then
    return new;
  end if;

  perform private.proc_assert_permission('admin.users.manage');

  if tg_op='UPDATE' and old.id=auth.uid() and old.role_key='admin'
     and (new.role_key<>'admin' or new.active=false) then
    raise exception 'You cannot remove your own Super Admin access';
  end if;
  return case when tg_op='DELETE' then old else new end;
end $function$

 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
SELECT c.id,c.name,l.id,l.section_id,l.sort_order,
 CASE
 WHEN c.name='BOARD ITEMS' THEN
   CASE
    WHEN l.sort_order BETWEEN 0 AND 6 THEN ARRAY['BOARD ITEMS','PLYWOOD BOARDS']
    WHEN l.sort_order BETWEEN 7 AND 13 THEN ARRAY['BOARD ITEMS','MDF BOARDS']
    WHEN l.sort_order BETWEEN 14 AND 41 THEN ARRAY['BOARD ITEMS','MELAMINE BOARDS',COALESCE(NULLIF(upper(i.colour),''),'FINISH TO REVIEW')]
    WHEN l.sort_order BETWEEN 42 AND 48 THEN ARRAY['BOARD ITEMS','FILM-FACED BOARDS']
    WHEN l.sort_order BETWEEN 49 AND 55 THEN ARRAY['BOARD ITEMS','SHUTTERING BOARDS']

    WHEN l.sort_order IN (64,65) THEN ARRAY['BOARD ITEMS','PVC BOARDS']
    ELSE NULL::text[] END
 WHEN c.name='FEVICOL' THEN ARRAY['FEVICOL',coalesce(nullif(i.main_group,''),'PRODUCT TYPE TO REVIEW'),coalesce(nullif(i.subgroup,''),'SERIES TO REVIEW')]
 WHEN c.name='POLYCHROME' THEN
  CASE WHEN i.main_group IN ('ENCLOSURE BOXES','SUNK BOXES') THEN

   ELSE ARRAY['POLYCHROME',coalesce(nullif(i.main_group,''),'PRODUCT TYPE TO REVIEW')] END
 WHEN c.name='ROCKER' THEN ARRAY['ROCKER',coalesce(nullif(i.main_group,''),'PRODUCT TYPE TO REVIEW')]
 WHEN c.name='WURTH' THEN ARRAY['WURTH',CASE
    WHEN i.description ILIKE '%SILICONE%' THEN 'SEALANTS'
    WHEN i.description ILIKE '%ANCHORING%' THEN 'ANCHORING ADHESIVES'
    WHEN i.description ILIKE '%CUTTING WHEEL%' THEN 'CUTTING WHEELS'
    WHEN i.description ILIKE '%WEATHER SHIELD%' THEN 'WEATHERPROOFING'
    WHEN i.description ILIKE '%RUST OFF%' THEN 'RUST TREATMENT'
    ELSE 'OTHER PRODUCTS — REVIEW' END]
 WHEN c.name='KOBE' THEN ARRAY['KOBE',CASE
    WHEN i.description ILIKE '%LED FLOODLIGHT%' THEN 'LED FLOODLIGHTS'
    WHEN i.description ILIKE '%WHEELBARROW%' THEN 'WHEELBARROWS'
    WHEN i.description ILIKE '%CROWBAR%' THEN 'CROWBARS'
    WHEN i.description ILIKE '%SHOVEL%' THEN 'SHOVELS'
    WHEN i.description ILIKE '%PADLOCK%' THEN 'PADLOCKS'
    ELSE 'OTHER PRODUCTS — REVIEW' END]
 WHEN c.name='MULTI BOND' THEN ARRAY['MULTI BOND',
   CASE WHEN nullif(i.subgroup,'') IS NULL OR i.subgroup='MULTI BOND'
        THEN 'GENERAL — TYPE UNCONFIRMED' ELSE i.subgroup END]
 WHEN c.name='CASING' THEN ARRAY['CASING',CASE WHEN l.sort_order BETWEEN 0 AND 3 THEN 'STANDARD SIZES' ELSE 'RECTANGULAR SIZES' END]
 WHEN c.name='RUBBER HOSE' THEN ARRAY['RUBBER HOSE',
    CASE WHEN l.sort_order IN (0,1) THEN '1/2IN'
         WHEN l.sort_order IN (2,3) THEN '3/4IN'
         ELSE '1IN' END]
 WHEN c.name='BIXTON' THEN ARRAY['BIXTON',
   CASE WHEN l.sort_order BETWEEN 0 AND 7 THEN 'DAYLIGHT (DL)' ELSE 'WARM WHITE' END,
   CASE WHEN upper(i.variation)='SUNK' THEN 'SUNK' WHEN upper(i.variation)='SURFACE' THEN 'SURFACE'
        ELSE 'MOUNTING TO REVIEW' END]
 WHEN c.name='BOLT & NUTS' THEN
   CASE WHEN s.name='YP BOLT' AND i.size IS NOT NULL THEN ARRAY['BOLT & NUTS','YP BOLT',upper(i.size)]
        WHEN s.name='YP Washer' AND i.variation IS NOT NULL THEN ARRAY['BOLT & NUTS','YP Washer',upper(i.variation)]
        ELSE NULL::text[] END
 WHEN c.name='WIRE CABLES' THEN ARRAY['WIRE CABLES',s.name,
   CASE WHEN l.sort_order BETWEEN 0 AND 29 THEN '1044 WIRES'
    WHEN l.sort_order BETWEEN 30 AND 54 THEN '7053 WIRES'
    WHEN l.sort_order BETWEEN 55 AND 79 THEN '7067 WIRES'
    WHEN l.sort_order BETWEEN 80 AND 94 THEN '7044 MAIN'
    WHEN l.sort_order BETWEEN 95 AND 99 THEN '7085 WIRES'
    WHEN l.sort_order BETWEEN 100 AND 104 THEN 'SINGLE-CORE WIRES'
    WHEN l.sort_order BETWEEN 105 AND 109 THEN 'TT WIRES'
    WHEN l.sort_order BETWEEN 110 AND 114 THEN 'COAXIAL CABLES'
    WHEN l.sort_order BETWEEN 115 AND 149 THEN 'MULTICORE CABLES'
    ELSE 'TYPE TO REVIEW' END]
 WHEN c.name='KEVILTON' THEN ARRAY['KEVILTON',s.name,
   CASE WHEN nullif(i.main_group,'') IS NULL OR i.main_group='KEVILTON'
   THEN 'PRODUCT TYPE TO REVIEW' ELSE i.main_group END]
 WHEN c.name='ORANGE' THEN
   CASE WHEN l.sort_order BETWEEN 0 AND 54 THEN
     ARRAY['ORANGE',s.name,coalesce(nullif(i.main_group,''),'PRODUCT TYPE TO REVIEW')]
   WHEN l.sort_order BETWEEN 55 AND 58 THEN
     ARRAY['ORANGE','CORDS & INSULATION',CASE WHEN l.sort_order<=57 THEN 'EXTENSION CORDS' ELSE 'INSULATION TAPE' END]
   WHEN l.sort_order BETWEEN 59 AND 65 THEN ARRAY['ORANGE','ELECTRICAL PROTECTION','ALPHA']
   WHEN l.sort_order BETWEEN 66 AND 72 THEN ARRAY['ORANGE','ELECTRICAL PROTECTION','SIGMA']
   ELSE NULL::text[] END
 WHEN c.name='PANEL SHEETS' AND l.sort_order BETWEEN 12 AND 29 THEN ARRAY['PANEL SHEETS','I PANEL',
   CASE floor((l.sort_order-12)/2)
    WHEN 0 THEN 'TEAK'
    WHEN 1 THEN 'BURMA TEAK'
    WHEN 2 THEN 'PVST 007'
    WHEN 3 THEN 'PVST 04'
    WHEN 4 THEN 'PVST 12A'
    WHEN 5 THEN 'PVST 21A'
    WHEN 6 THEN 'PVST 16A'
    WHEN 7 THEN 'PVST 10A'
    ELSE 'APPLE WOOD' END]
 ELSE NULL::text[]
 END::text[] AS section_path
FROM public.proc_company_list_items l
JOIN public.proc_companies c ON c.id=l.company_id
JOIN public.proc_items i ON i.id=l.item_id
LEFT JOIN public.proc_company_sections s ON s.id=l.section_id

'CASING','RUBBER HOSE','BIXTON','BOLT & NUTS','WIRE CABLES','KEVILTON','ORANGE','PANEL SHEETS')

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.proc_search_stock_items_v1(p_query text, p_category text DEFAULT NULL::text, p_main_group text DEFAULT NULL::text, p_movement text DEFAULT NULL::text, p_limit integer DEFAULT 20)
 RETURNS TABLE(item_id uuid, item_code text, category text, brand text, description text, main_group text, subgroup text, size text, uom text, movement text, max_stock numeric, reorder_level numeric, book_stock numeric, last_counted_at timestamp with time zone, is_due boolean, search_rank integer)
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
with
q as (
  select lower(trim(coalesce(p_query,''))) as term,
         greatest(5,least(coalesce(p_limit,20),50)) as lim
),
loc as (
  select id from public.proc_locations where active=true order by created_at limit 1
),
base as (
  select i.id item_id,i.item_code,i.category,i.brand,i.description,i.main_group,i.subgroup,i.size,i.uom,i.movement,i.max_stock,i.reorder_level,
         b.qty book_stock,b.last_counted_at,
         lower(concat_ws(' ',i.item_code,i.description,i.brand,i.category,i.main_group,i.subgroup,i.size,i.uom)) search_text
  from public.proc_items i
  cross join loc
  left join public.proc_stock_balances b on b.item_id=i.id and b.location_id=loc.id
  where i.active=true
    and (nullif(trim(coalesce(p_category,'')),'') is null or i.category=p_category)
    and (nullif(trim(coalesce(p_main_group,'')),'') is null or i.main_group=p_main_group)
    and (nullif(trim(coalesce(p_movement,'')),'') is null or i.movement=p_movement)
),
matched as (
  select b.*,q.term,q.lim,
    case
      when q.term='' then 99
      when lower(coalesce(b.item_code,''))=q.term then 0
      when lower(coalesce(b.size,''))=q.term then 1
      when lower(b.description)=q.term then 2
      when lower(coalesce(b.item_code,'')) like q.term||'%' then 3
      when lower(b.description) like q.term||'%' then 4
      when lower(coalesce(b.size,'')) like q.term||'%' then 5
      when lower(coalesce(b.brand,'')) like q.term||'%' then 6
      when position(q.term in b.search_text)>0 then 7
      else 20
    end as rank_value
  from base b cross join q
  where q.term='' or not exists (
    select 1 from regexp_split_to_table(q.term,'\s+') token
    where token<>'' and position(token in b.search_text)=0
  )
)
select m.item_id,m.item_code,m.category,m.brand,m.description,m.main_group,m.subgroup,m.size,m.uom,m.movement,
       m.max_stock,m.reorder_level,m.book_stock,m.last_counted_at,coalesce(d.is_due,true) is_due,m.rank_value search_rank
from matched m
left join public.proc_v_stock_check_due d on d.item_id=m.item_id
order by m.rank_value,lower(m.description),lower(coalesce(m.size,'')),lower(m.item_code)
limit (select lim from q);
$function$

  where r.id=any(p_requirement_ids)
),
supplier_base as (
  select s.id,s.supplier_code,s.name,
         not exists(
           select 1
           from public.proc_supplier_scopes sc
           where sc.supplier_id=s.id
         ) unrestricted
  from public.proc_suppliers s
  where s.active=true
),
matches as (
  select
    sb.id supplier_id,
    sb.supplier_code,
    sb.name supplier_name,
    sb.unrestricted,
    count(req.item_id) filter(
      where sb.unrestricted
         or exists(
           select 1
           from public.proc_supplier_scopes sc
           where sc.supplier_id=sb.id
             and (
               (sc.scope_type='item' and sc.item_id=req.item_id)
               or (sc.scope_type='category' and sc.scope_value=req.category)
               or (sc.scope_type='main_group' and sc.scope_value=req.main_group)
               or (sc.scope_type='subgroup' and sc.scope_value=req.subgroup)
             )
         )
    )::integer matched_items,
    (select count(*)::integer from req) selected_items
  from supplier_base sb
  cross join req
  group by sb.id,sb.supplier_code,sb.name,sb.unrestricted
)
select supplier_id,supplier_code,supplier_name,matched_items,selected_items,unrestricted
from matches
where matched_items>0
order by matched_items desc,unrestricted asc,supplier_name asc
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.proc_supplier_performance_report_v1(p_from date DEFAULT NULL::date, p_to date DEFAULT NULL::date)
 RETURNS TABLE(supplier_id uuid, supplier_code text, supplier_name text, active boolean, quote_count bigint, quoted_line_count bigint, avg_quoted_lead_days numeric, awarded_line_count bigint, awarded_qty numeric, awarded_value numeric, po_count bigint, po_value numeric, completed_fill_rate_pct numeric, invoice_count bigint, invoice_variance_count bigint)
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
with quote_stats as (
  select q.supplier_id,
    count(distinct q.id) quote_count,
    avg(ql.lead_days) filter(where ql.lead_days is not null) avg_quoted_lead_days,
    count(*) filter(where ql.id is not null) quoted_line_count
  from public.proc_quotes q
  left join public.proc_quote_lines ql on ql.quote_id=q.id
  where (p_from is null or q.quote_date>=p_from)
    and (p_to is null or q.quote_date<=p_to)
  group by q.supplier_id
),
award_stats as (
  select a.supplier_id,
    count(*) awarded_line_count,
    sum(a.awarded_qty) awarded_qty,
    sum(a.awarded_qty*coalesce(a.landed_unit_cost,a.effective_unit_cost,a.unit_price)) awarded_value
  from public.proc_awards a
  where (p_from is null or a.awarded_at::date>=p_from)
    and (p_to is null or a.awarded_at::date<=p_to)
  group by a.supplier_id
),
po_stats as (
  select po.supplier_id,
    count(distinct po.id) po_count,
    sum(po.total) filter(where po.status<>'cancelled') po_value
  from public.proc_purchase_orders po
  where (p_from is null or po.po_date>=p_from)
    and (p_to is null or po.po_date<=p_to)
  group by po.supplier_id
),
fill_stats as (
  select po.supplier_id,
    sum(pl.qty) filter(where po.status in ('received','closed')) completed_order_qty,
    sum(coalesce(rec.accepted_qty,0)) filter(where po.status in ('received','closed')) completed_accepted_qty
  from public.proc_purchase_orders po
  join public.proc_po_lines pl on pl.po_id=po.id
  left join (
    select gl.po_line_id,sum(gl.accepted_qty) accepted_qty
    from public.proc_grn_lines gl
    join public.proc_grns g on g.id=gl.grn_id and g.status='posted'
    group by gl.po_line_id
  ) rec on rec.po_line_id=pl.id
  where (p_from is null or po.po_date>=p_from)
    and (p_to is null or po.po_date<=p_to)
  group by po.supplier_id
),
invoice_stats as (
  select si.supplier_id,
    count(*) invoice_count,
    count(*) filter(where si.status='variance') invoice_variance_count
  from public.proc_supplier_invoices si
  where (p_from is null or si.invoice_date>=p_from)
    and (p_to is null or si.invoice_date<=p_to)
  group by si.supplier_id
)
select
  s.id,
  s.supplier_code,
  s.name,
  s.active,
  coalesce(qs.quote_count,0),
  coalesce(qs.quoted_line_count,0),
  round(coalesce(qs.avg_quoted_lead_days,0),1),
  coalesce(a.awarded_line_count,0),
  coalesce(a.awarded_qty,0),
  round(coalesce(a.awarded_value,0),2),
  coalesce(p.po_count,0),
  round(coalesce(p.po_value,0),2),
  case when coalesce(f.completed_order_qty,0)>0
    then round(coalesce(f.completed_accepted_qty,0)/f.completed_order_qty*100,1)
    else null end,
  coalesce(iv.invoice_count,0),
  coalesce(iv.invoice_variance_count,0)
from public.proc_suppliers s
left join quote_stats qs on qs.supplier_id=s.id
left join award_stats a on a.supplier_id=s.id
left join po_stats p on p.supplier_id=s.id
left join fill_stats f on f.supplier_id=s.id
left join invoice_stats iv on iv.supplier_id=s.id
order by s.name
$function$
